basics.name: Austin Meadows
basics.label: Computational Scientist
basics.summary: PhD-trained computational scientist with a decade of experience turning complex oncology questions into reproducible statistical code, analytic datasets, and real-world evidence. Cancer-research background spans hepatocellular carcinoma, melanoma, and immuno-oncology, including a Nature Communications consortium benchmark of statistical cell-type deconvolution methods. Fluent in R (tidyverse) and Python with deep multi-omics, statistical analysis, and machine-learning experience across 8 peer-reviewed publications and $4.4M in funded research.

work.name: Immunome AI Biotechnologies
work.summary: AI platform for immune profiling and drug-target discovery (New York, NY)
highlights: Co-developed iMEMORY, an AI platform generating clinically relevant immune-profiling and drug-target-discovery insights from heterogeneous patient data, advising on platform design and biological interpretation of model outputs
Nominated in-silico therapeutic gene targets and supplied doctoral datasets used in a cross-species validation of the platform's predictions
Produced investor-facing scientific materials and presentations that translated complex model outputs for non-technical stakeholders

work.name: Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai / Instituto de Salud Carlos III
work.position: Ph.D. Candidate, Biomedical Sciences & Public Health
work.summary: Pathology of trained immunity in the lab of Dr. Jordi Ochando (New York, NY / Madrid, Spain)
highlights: Designed and coordinated a multi-omics study of trained immunity, generating and analyzing ATAC-seq, RNA-seq, and CUT&RUN data through reproducible, version-controlled R and Python pipelines
Built the first ex-vivo model and the first clinical-setting diagnostic for dialysis-mediated trained immunity, bridging bench data to a translational clinical readout
Authored a publication-grade manuscript end to end, including the statistical analysis plan, descriptive and inferential statistics, and all figures

work.name: Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai
work.summary: Genomics and computational-biology subject-matter expert, Tisch Cancer Institute
highlights: Generated the preliminary data underpinning successful NIAID and NCI grant applications totaling $4.4M
Served as genomics and computational-biology subject-matter expert for multiple labs across the Tisch Cancer Institute, MGH, and WashU, delivering analyses in a cross-institutional environment
Elucidated the mechanism of action of novel hepatocellular-carcinoma chemotherapy WNTinib (Rialdi et al., Nature Cancer, 2023)
Identified two protein complexes whose disruption arrests melanoma cell-cycle progression, enabling a new epigenetic strategy for drug-resistant melanoma (Jostes et al., Genes & Development, 2024)
Developed the first nanoparticle biologic to attenuate allograft fibrosis by silencing immune training (Mineura et al., Am. J. Transplantation, 2026)

work.name: Girihlet, Inc.
work.summary: Next-generation sequencing services for the NYC research community
highlights: Engineered a Python interface that automated creation and submission of NGS protocols to a liquid-handling robot, eliminating manual workflows and saving tens of thousands of dollars in annual overhead
Delivered tailored NGS services and experimental consultation to NYC-area biomedical research clients

work.name: NYIT College of Osteopathic Medicine
work.summary: Computational and translational research, Dept. of Biomedical Sciences (Long Island, NY)
highlights: Built an in-silico cell-type deconvolution method estimating tumor composition from bulk RNA-seq; benchmarked against community methods in a Nature Communications consortium study (White et al., 2024)

Extended the CPA algorithm with a machine-learning post-processing layer (CNN + autoencoder) for single-molecule localization microscopy, trained on a synthetic dataset generated from a physical model of the microscope

education.institution: Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai / Instituto de Salud Carlos III

publications.name: Myeloid-avid mTOR-inhibiting nanobiologic attenuates allograft fibrosis after lung transplantation
publications.summary: A myeloid-targeted, mTOR-inhibiting nanobiologic that silences trained immunity to attenuate allograft fibrosis following lung transplantation.

publications.name: Investigating the induction of trained immunity in myeloid-derived monocytes following extracorporeal circulation
publications.summary: Characterizing the induction of trained immunity in myeloid-derived monocytes following extracorporeal circulation.

publications.name: Community assessment of methods to deconvolve cellular composition from bulk gene expression
publications.summary: A community-wide DREAM Challenge benchmarking deconvolution methods reveals that while many accurately infer immune cell infiltration in tumors, deep learning approaches improve detection of functional T cell states, providing valuable resources for method development.

publications.name: H2A.Z chaperones converge on E2F target genes for melanoma cell proliferation
publications.summary: H2A.Z chaperone complexes SRCAP and P400–TIP60 coordinate H2A.Z deposition and H4 acetylation to promote melanoma proliferation, with YL1 overexpression linked to poor prognosis and apoptosis upon its loss, highlighting them as potential therapeutic targets.

publications.name: Active Learning Exercises in Synaptic Physiology and Connectivity for the Neuroscience Lecture Hall, Laboratory Course, or Outreach Setting
publications.summary: We present novel active learning exercises for teaching neuronal circuits and synaptic connectivity in lecture-based neuroscience courses to enhance student understanding and retention.

publications.name: WNTinib is a multi-kinase inhibitor with specificity against beta-catenin mutant hepatocellular carcinoma
publications.summary: WNTinib, a selective multi-kinase inhibitor, effectively targets CTNNB1-mutant hepatocellular carcinoma by inhibiting KIT/MAPK signaling and engaging EZH2-mediated transcriptional repression, offering a potent and durable therapy with high specificity and safety.

publications.name: The T cell receptor repertoire reflects the dynamics of the immune response to vaccination
publications.summary: Tseek, a novel TCR repertoire sequencing method, enables early, detailed, and non-invasive profiling of individual T cell responses to vaccines, revealing unique immune dynamics and potential for personalized immune monitoring.

publications.name: Click chemistry approaches to expand the repertoire of PEG-based fluorinated surfactants for droplet microfluidics
publications.summary: We developed a simplified, click chemistry-based synthesis of novel fluorinated PFPE–PEG surfactants that stabilize droplets in microfluidics, enabling easier production of diverse, biocompatible emulsions.
